articles.title: Grant Thornton Sounds €3.7 Billion Gas Alarm: Greece Faces a Costly Winter as Europe’s Energy Risks Mount
articles.description: European gas prices have almost tripled in eight months, storage levels are significantly lower, and competition for LNG cargoes is intensifying. Meanwhile, Greece’s natural gas exports have surged by 169%, strengthening its position as a regional energy hub while exposing the economy to greater international market volatility.
